news.title: Wall Street Journal board warns Trump against ‘economic bailout’ in Iran deal
news.summary: The Wall Street Journal editorial board on Sunday pushed back on the reported terms of a peace deal being negotiated by the Trump administration and Iranian government. The board wrote that while the administration “can claim real achievements” from the war, the ceasefire period “may deliver a strategic setback” for the U.S. Multiple outlets reported…
